A.hint: Start at bottom left, go up to the peak, then down!

B.hint: Draw a tall line down, then make two bumps on the right!

C.hint: Start on the right, curve all the way around to the left!

D.hint: Draw a line down, then curve around to the right!

E.hint: Draw the top line left, then down, add a middle line, then the bottom!

F.hint: Draw the top line left, then all the way down, then add a middle line!

G.hint: Like a C, but at the end bring your finger in to make a shelf!

H.hint: Draw a line down, then another line down on the right, then connect them!

I.hint: Draw the top line, then go straight down, then the bottom line!

J.hint: Draw the top line, then go down and curve left at the bottom!

K.hint: Draw a line down, then a diagonal up-right from the middle, then down-right!

L.hint: Draw a line straight down, then go right along the bottom!

M.hint: Go up the left side, come down to the middle V, then up and down the right!

N.hint: Go up the left side, then diagonally down-right, then up the right side!

O.hint: Start at the top and draw a big oval all the way around!

P.hint: Draw a line up, then make a bump on the upper right!

Q.hint: Draw a big O, then add a little tail in the bottom right!

R.hint: Draw a line up, make a bump on the right, then kick your leg down-right!

S.hint: Start at the top right and curve left, then curve right at the bottom!

T.hint: Draw a line all the way across the top, then go straight down the middle!

U.hint: Go down the left side, curve around the bottom, then go back up!

V.hint: Go diagonally down to the bottom middle, then diagonally back up!

W.hint: Go down to the left valley, up to the middle peak, down to the right valley, then back up!

X.hint: Draw a diagonal line down-right, then cross it going down-left!

Y.hint: Draw a V shape to the middle, then go straight down!

Z.hint: Draw the top line, then diagonally down to the left, then the bottom line!

c.hint: Open arc — start top-right, curve left!

h.hint: Ascender down, arch right, stem down!

j.hint: Dot, stem, hook left at bottom!

p.hint: Stem down past baseline, bump right!

r.hint: Up then arch partway to the right!

y.hint: Two diagonals to center, then hook down!
